completed_scope: For each fixed smooth mean-zero solenoidal2pi-periodic u, a bounded periodic vector potential and fixed-thickness cutoff yield compactly supported solenoidal W_R equal to u on an exact union of periodic cells.
The full regularized gradient-norm dissipation is compared through D=-integral B(G):Delta G, including zero-set contributions. D and rank-one defect Q have O_u(R^2) errors; Q error is nonnegative.
The canonical Poisson correction e_R=f_R+Delta(chi_R p) is supported in the closed O(R^2) cutoff layer and has L2 norm O_u(R). Unitary-Fourier Plancherel gives exact Hessian-Newton L2 norm.
The signed joint production P differs from m_R P_periodic by O_u(R^(5/2)), including the entire nonlocal pressure correction. Dividing by m_R~R^3 gives convergence.
Targeted route comparison distinguished this static tool from existing velocity-L3 pressure-work localization and from fixed-positive-age/common-critical-cap dynamics.
limitations: C_u depends on the fixed periodic seed and its smooth derivatives, not only total kinetic energy; no uniformity over changing amplitudes or preterminal time intervals is claimed.

No cutoff of an evolving field was called an NS trajectory. Subsequent single-copy NS scaling, torus re-embedding, pressure correction for re-embedding, and new NS solution-family construction were not completed or frozen in this note.
Even a strengthened initial-slice energy-cap countercheck would not resolve the fixed-positive-age/common-local-A+E question. This static lemma is not a new terminal obstruction or example count.
Miller/strain-wave-cone and scalar heat-correction entries were already covered locally. No newly adopted external critical estimate, exhaustive novelty search or human peer review.
PF automatic joint good scale remains open, and the next concrete dynamical estimate has not been selected.
